note: The Part D elements: what a signal is made of, as lights.json is what a light display is made of. An element carries its Rule 32 or Annex III duration and the appliance that makes it; an entry in applicability.json sequences them. ADR 0022.

sound:bell_rapid.note: One element, not a count of strokes: 35(g) states a duration and leaves the stroke rate to the appliance.

sound:bell_stroke.note: A separate and distinct stroke. 35(h) counts these, so no duration is stated and the sequence carries the count.

flash:manoeuvring.note: The manoeuvring light of 34(b)(iii): all-round white, 5 miles, fitted or not. Its character is light:flashing; the sequence, not the light, carries the meaning.

appliances.note: Rule 33's carriage thresholds, a standard rather than an entry: what a vessel of a given length is provided with. `alternative` is 33(a)'s replacement clause, `fallback` is 33(b)'s.

carriage.alternative: other equipment having the same sound characteristics, provided manual sounding of the prescribed signals stays possible
other equipment having the same sound characteristics, provided manual sounding of the prescribed signals stays possible
carriage.note: The tone and sound of the gong may not be confused with that of the bell.

fallback.requirement: not obliged to carry the appliances of 33(a), but shall be provided with some other means of making an efficient signal
